mapper.select: SELECT * FROM operation_log WHERE uuid = CAST(#{uuid} AS uuid) AND is_del = false
SELECT ol.* FROM operation_log ol LEFT JOIN project p ON ol.project_id = p.id WHERE p.uuid = CAST(#{projectUuid} AS uuid) AND ol.is_del = false ORDER BY ol.create_time DESC
SELECT ol.* FROM operation_log ol LEFT JOIN collect_task ct ON ol.task_id = ct.id WHERE ct.uuid = CAST(#{taskUuid} AS uuid) AND ol.is_del = false ORDER BY ol.create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM operation_log WHERE log_date = #{logDate} AND creator_id = #{creatorId} AND is_del = false ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM operation_log WHERE is_del = false
AND (project_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR task_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
mapper.update: UPDATE operation_log SET content = #{content}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE uuid = CAST(#{uuid} AS uuid) AND is_del = false
UPDATE operation_log SET is_del = true, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE uuid = CAST(#{uuid} AS uuid)
